objective: Secure actual previously published original third-party upstream HTTP recordings for normal and application-error, plus a separately owned first-party-to-them original MCP CI artifact; never stitch these into a fabricated same-call evidence chain.

original_replay.recorder: pytest VCR originals, redacted; third-party-authored tests; source reports dated real upstream JPO snapshots, not independently wire-notarized

files.role: HTTP upstream response recorded during MCP-tool dispatcher Python call
HTTP upstream error in application payload recorded during direct SDK call, NOT a recorded MCP dispatch

original_ci_artifact.inspection_only: 8 JSON results + 8 Markdown reports; MCP discovery checks; no proven upstream HTTP REST-to-MCP tool pair. CI original ZIP obtained unchanged from connected GitHub download.

qualification_thresholds.real_upstream_success: JPO VCR success: recorded original external API HTTP 200, application statusCode 100, in an independently authored in-process MCP tool dispatcher test
qualification_thresholds.real_upstream_logical_error: JPO VCR application status 107 with HTTP 200, but observed in JpoClient test, not MCP invocation
qualification_thresholds.independent_mcp_ci: Original MCP Observatory publicly downloadable CI artifact with independently generated MCP server discovery reports
qualification_thresholds.no_false_pairing: No different external project's artifact joined to JPO VCR. No in-process MCP tool handler labeled as actual wire tools/call. HTTP 200 with application status 107 is not an HTTP non-2xx or MCP isError.

security: Original VCR contains HTTP headers and public patent response values; never upload raw cassettes to RISU CI artifacts; publish source hashes and aggregate extracted fields only. Original third-party CI artifact is linked and optionally shared separately for original provenance. No external code is executed.
